newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 dawdles at weaker levels, awaits BoE.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 dawdles at weaker levels, awaits BoE.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 continued weaker as the market awaited a decision from the Bank of England on base rates due at noon.
Strategists said the market is expecting a quarter-point rise to 6.75 percent but would prefer a half-point which would be taken as a strong first move to curb consumer spending.

"After the figures yesterday from (electrical retailer) Dixons and and other retail data and consumers' generally buoyant mood, the budget has not hurt sentiment and people would be shocked if we didn't get an increase," said Roger Monson, stategist at Daiwa.
